title: Sign encoding of an affine Boolean function
statement: Let $b\in\mathbb F_2$ and $a\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The real sign encoding of the affine function $x\mapsto b+a\cdot x$ equals the real function $x\mapsto (-1)^b\chi_a(x)$, where $\chi_a$ is the Walsh character associated with $a$.
